Description: Date2gether academic demo in us-east-2: one EC2 with application, PostgreSQL, LiveKit and automatic HTTPS/TURN. No Chime or paid-plan upgrade. Root disk retained when terminated; backup and remove separately after the demo.

SubnetId.Description: Public subnet in that VPC, with Internet Gateway route

InstanceType.Description: t3.medium recommended for the complete demo; small has less memory

RepositoryUrl.Description: Public repository with the reviewed deployment files

GitRef.Description: Prefer an exact reviewed commit SHA, already pushed to the repository

BaseDomain.Description: Base domain whose app/media/turn subdomains resolve to this IP. Empty uses IP.sslip.io for a temporary demo.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Only public HTTPS/ACME and WebRTC/TURN transports are reachable. Administration uses SSM, not SSH.
must: Public media ingress is necessary for invited browsers on different networks

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: Application HTTPS, LiveKit WSS and TURN TLS using SNI

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Access through Session Manager without an SSH key. The application itself does not call AWS APIs.
must: Only the standard SSM instance policy; no application AWS keys

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Attach the SSM role to the EC2 host.
must: Do not grant administrative access to the host role

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Stable IPv4 keeps invitation, media and TURN hostnames valid across stops.
must: Release it when the demo is retired; it is charged even when EC2 is stopped

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Single-host academic demo with a 6-participant default, encrypted root disk and automatic stop.
must: Root EBS remains after termination to preserve PostgreSQL data; remove deliberately after backup
No secrets in UserData; generate them on the encrypted host

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-2
dnf install -y docker git python3
systemctl enable --now docker amazon-ssm-agent
mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
curl --retry 5 -fsSL https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v2.40.3/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
curl --retry 5 -fsSL https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v2.40.3/checksums.txt -o /tmp/compose-checksums.txt
(cd /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins && sha256sum --check --ignore-missing /tmp/compose-checksums.txt)
chmod 755 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
imdsToken=$(curl --retry 10 -fsS -X PUT -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 600' http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token)
for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
  observedIp=$(curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $imdsToken" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-ipv4 || true)
  if [ "$observedIp" = '${DemoAddress}' ]; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
[ "$observedIp" = '${DemoAddress}' ] || { echo 'Elastic IP association not ready' >&2; exit 1; }
privateIp=$(curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $imdsToken" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4)
install -d -m 700 /opt/date2gether
cd /opt/date2gether
git init
git remote add origin '${RepositoryUrl}'
git fetch --depth 1 origin '${GitRef}'
git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
python3 deploy/ec2/configure.py --public-ip '${DemoAddress}' --private-ip "$privateIp" --domain '${BaseDomain}' --participants '${ParticipantLimit}'
# Auto-stop on every boot. EBS and the reserved IPv4 remain billable while stopped.
cat > /etc/systemd/system/date2gether-autostop.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Stop academic demo to limit compute usage
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/shutdown -h now
UNIT
cat > /etc/systemd/system/date2gether-autostop.timer <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Stop Date2gether EC2 two hours after boot
[Timer]
OnBootSec=2h
Unit=date2gether-autostop.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now date2gether-autostop.timer
bash deploy/ec2/start.sh

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Attach the stable address after the instance is running.
must: Bootstrap waits for this association before generating hostnames

ApplicationUrl.Description: Application URL; usable only after cloud-init and TLS issuance succeed

MediaUrl.Description: Media URL; usable only after cloud-init and TLS issuance succeed
